active_release_candidate.purpose: Keep the precise source-scoped native Video model-card UI while adding a marked reversible shared-schema fallback and cache-busted Dashboard delivery for real installations where the transformed bundle is stale or not re-requested.

current_goal.goal: Preserve the recovered per-model native Video capability and all 0.1.19+ rich model-card features, while making the Video control survive stale/cached Dashboard delivery. Prefer exact source-scoped private-clone isolation; tolerate a marked shared-schema fallback only as a delivery safety net whose foreign state is stripped before persistence and runtime.
non_goals: Do not restore the retired Provider Source master switch or Source model selector.
Do not replace the native model-card modalities Video selection with a custom request field or hidden Boolean.
Do not delete or simplify the 0.1.19+ per-model request fields, audio path, compressed/original video quality, Agent Plan channel, migration logic, or request overrides while fixing UI delivery.
Do not allow fallback Video selected on a foreign Provider card to persist or affect a foreign Provider request.
Do not remove a future AstrBot-native Video modality merely because the plugin fallback uses the same option value.
Do not claim 0.1.23 runtime publication or a real user installation until the publisher and external reinstall are directly observed.

active_validation_frontier.name: robust_model_card_video_delivery_and_cache_resilience

observed: The 0.1.22 source-scoped private-dialog implementation remains the preferred precise path and its recovery anchor remains frozen at archive/model-card-video-known-good-0.1.22.

Real Source-Type Video Differential run 31786801753 used AstrBot 4.27.3, the repository HUOSHANYINQINGAPI secret, the same https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3 endpoint, and the same real model deepseek-r1-250120 for both an AstrBot-native OpenAI Source and the plugin Ark Source. Both Sources returned 129 models with 129-model overlap; OpenAI rendered four modalities while plugin Ark rendered a fifth Video modality, and save/reopen persistence remained source-scoped.

The candidate adds a marked reversible shared-schema Video fallback, a foreign create/update save guard that strips only fallback Video, and a content-derived query suffix on the compatible Dashboard bundle so a stale cached asset cannot satisfy the post-install request.
The candidate does not modify providers.py, adapters/video.py, capabilities/model_fields.py, the audio path, Agent Plan request routing, or the 0.1.19 rich model-field definitions.

PR #15 candidate head ab54a4cdb4bb676ab0cf8a4619d11909bb9d51c8 passed Runtime Distribution Gate run 31787137849 on AstrBot 4.26.1 and 4.27.2, Model-card Video Contract run 31787137830 on a real AstrBot 4.27.3 Dashboard including the new robust-delivery contract, and 0.1.19 Compatibility Baseline Dashboard Regression run 31787137853.

The fallback changes the failure preference from fail-closed UI disappearance to bounded visual degradation: if the precise frontend clone patch cannot run, a foreign dialog may temporarily display Video, but the foreign save boundary strips it and the plugin does not route foreign requests.

stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, fallback, retry, model-card management, and the base shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin adapts Volcengine request and media protocols; it does not maintain a second global model-capability database.
The user-facing Video truth remains the native per-model-card modalities selection. The precise UI path scopes it to the two plugin-owned Source types after a private dialog clone exists.

A marked reversible shared-schema Video option is permitted only as the 0.1.23 delivery fallback. It is not a supplier-wide capability claim, must be removed from foreign private clones when the precise bridge runs, and must be stripped from foreign create/update payloads before persistence.
Future AstrBot-native Video support is host-owned and must not be deleted by plugin fallback cleanup.
Request transport settings are not permanent model-capability facts.

The 0.1.19+ rich per-model request fields, audio path, video quality modes, Agent Plan routing, migrations, and request override semantics are compatibility baseline behavior unless a separate validated change explicitly replaces them.
Development documentation, tests, evidence, and experiments stay outside the allow-list runtime package.
A passing gate proves only the object and layer named by that gate; real source-type differential, persistence, runtime behavior, and unload/release evidence remain distinct checks.
warning: Read verdict first, then docs/contracts/MODEL_CARD_VIDEO_CONTRACT.md for any Video/modalities/Provider-UI task. The 0.1.23 fallback is intentional bounded degradation for delivery robustness: do not delete it merely because it touches the shared schema, and do not broaden it into persistent or runtime behavior for foreign Providers.
